SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26-16349
PUC Docket No. 59475 

COMMISSION STAFF’S OBJECTIONS TO EXHIBITS IN SOAH ORDER nO. 30 
On March 26, 2026, Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation filed a joint application with the Public Utility Commission of Texas (Commission) to amend their respective certificates of convenience and necessity for the Bell County East Switch to Big Hill Substation 765-kilovolt (kV) transmission line project. 
On June 5, 2026, the administrative law judges (ALJs) from the State Office of Administrative Hearings (SOAH) filed SOAH Order No. 30, including a list of exhibits in Attachment A. Further, at the prehearing conference on June 5, 2026, the ALJs established June 7, 2026, as the deadline to make objections to the exhibits included in Attachment A. Therefore, this pleading is timely filed. 
OBJECTIONS TO EXHIBITS
Importantly, SOAH Order No. 30 indicated that Attachment A did not include: (1) exhibits designated as a demonstrative, (2) exhibits designated for purposes of cross-examination, (3) exhibits uploaded to Kiteworks that were not part of the prefiled direct testimony filed that party or are not a discovery response, or (4) exhibits with other procedural irregularities. Based on this understanding, Commission Staff (Staff) objects to Kennedy Ex N24 through Kennedy Ex N27 and Kennedy Ex PA02.3 provided by Kevin Kennedy (party number 374). Specifically, except for a portion of Kennedy Ex N 24 and Kennedy Ex N27, the exhibits are not discovery responses or part of Mr. Kennedy’s prefiled direct testimony. For purposes of Kennedy Ex PA02.3, Staff notes that such exhibit is duplicative of Staff Exhibit No. 1 and is therefore not necessary to admit as evidence. 
For purposes of Kennedy Ex N24 through Kennedy Ex N27 that are not discovery responses or part of Mr. Kennedy’s prefiled direct testimony, such portions are instead Staff’s objections to Mr. Kennedy’s requests for information. Discovery objections are legal arguments and not evidence. Further, to the extent Mr. Kennedy seeks to use these portions of the exhibits for purposes of cross-examining Staff witness John Poole, Staff maintains its objection to the admission and use such discovery objections as evidence. Notably, the requests for information to which Staff objected were not directed to Mr. Poole, as Staff had not yet identified Mr. Poole as Staff’s witness or filed his direct testimony. 
For purposes of Kennedy Ex N24 and Kennedy Ex N27 that do include discovery responses from Staff, to the extent that Mr. Kennedy seeks to use them for purposes of cross-examining Mr. Poole, Staff reserves the right to object to such admission and use of the discovery responses during the hearing on the merits. Notably, Staff highlights that such requests were not directed to Mr. Poole, nor did Mr. Poole sponsor the discovery responses included in such exhibits. 
CONCLUSION
For the reasons detailed above, Staff respectfully objects to the foregoing exhibits and respectfully reserves the right to object to portions of these exhibits as necessary.
Dated: June 7, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
